paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Comparison of the Improvement for 5-digit and 6-digit multiplication with as feedback model
model_annotation: This line plot, titled “Accuracy Improvement Over Iterations,” illustrates the progression of accuracy percentages for two distinct multiplication tasks—5-digit and 6-digit—across nine iterations. The x-axis, labeled “Iteration,” spans from 0 to 9 with integer tick marks at each unit interval. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, ranges from 0 to 90, with gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 20 percentage points. The plot displays two lines: the 6-digit multiplication performance is represented by a blue line with circular markers and a solid line, starting at 0% accuracy at iteration 0 and increasing to approximately 92% at iteration 9. The 5-digit multiplication performance is shown by an orange line with square markers and a solid line, beginning at 0% accuracy at iteration 0 and rising to approximately 88% at iteration 9. Both lines show a general upward trend, with the 6-digit line exhibiting a steeper initial increase before leveling off, while the 5-digit line shows a more gradual, steady climb.
